protocol.order: GPU-only block; four backends randomized per input and repeat
protocol.gpu_timing: synchronized wall time; inputs and outputs GPU resident through I/O binding
protocol.precision: Fresh paired FP32 (TF32 disabled) and FP16 GPU measurements; pure FP16 PyTorch weights/input, FP16 ONNX input/output.
protocol.limitation: single workstation session, not isolated from normal OS background activity
protocol.gpu_runtime: Official Microsoft onnxruntime-gpu; CUDA EP; CPU fallback prohibited.
protocol.validation: Numerical/top-1 agreement on supplied demonstrations; not held-out accuracy.

sampling.note: Sampled demonstration protocol; not the reported benchmark protocol.

export.scope: Inference logits only; no retraining, calibration or XAI export.
